Build a report envelope from a real repository at a named base and head

Usage: provenance report build [OPTIONS] --base <BASE> --head <HEAD> --repository <REPOSITORY>

Options:
      --quiet                    Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --repo <REPO>              [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>            [default: default]
      --base <BASE>              Older endpoint of the comparison range
      --head <HEAD>              Newer endpoint of the comparison range
      --repository <REPOSITORY>  Repository identity in `owner/name` form for report links
      --path <PATH>              Scan this path instead of the repository root; a partial scan is recorded as incomplete
      --output <OUTPUT>          Write the envelope JSON to this file instead of standard output
      --format <FORMAT>          [default: json] [possible values: json]
  -h, --help                     Print help
